\par\smallskip\raggedright
\textit{Note.} Ratio = max $\div$ min of the two hindsight RMSEs (the pre-registered definition in H2.4 and H4.3), so it is $\ge$ 1 and the 'lower' column gives the direction: in Experiment 4 the smoothed UKF is lower on flights 1 and 2 and the FGO whole-flight batch on flight 3. Aggregation differs: Experiment 2 is per condition from the means of 3 repeats (the RMSE over the 5 laps); Experiment 4 is per flight (indoor RMSE, 123 s). Experiment 2 is in the world frame with tag fixes at known positions; Experiment 4 in the world frame with GNSS outside only.\par
\textit{Note.} Cap-free smoothed-UKF variant in Experiment 4: max $\div$ min 1.01--1.05. The former 'FGO whole-flight batch \textasciitilde{}2$\times$ better than the smoothed UKF' in Experiment 4 is WITHDRAWN (a noise-model artefact). Hindsight here = the FGO whole-flight batch and the smoothed UKF (single-pass RTS smoother); Experiment 3's keyframe-FGO hindsight (iSAM2 full estimate) is a different estimator and is not in this table.\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
\textit{Note.} [a] Ordering basis, Experiment 2 hindsight, the FGO whole-flight batch against the smoothed UKF (H2.4). Metric: horizontal RMSE over the 5 laps in the world frame, mean of the flights in each condition, cm. n = 3 flights per condition, 4 conditions (both hindsight tracks from the same flights, paired). Rule: H2.4 'FGO hindsight $\approx$ RTS-UKF': in every condition the larger RMSE (mean over repeats) is $\le$ 1.5 $\times$ the smaller (METHODOLOGY.md:10180, METHODOLOGY.md:10181); no ordering test was registered. Result: max $\div$ min 1.31 / 2.14 / 2.06 / 3.89: H2.4 FAILS; the FGO whole-flight batch is the lower in every condition (descriptive). Verdict: case (ii), FAILED AS WORDED: the registered prediction is false as written; a failed criterion does not by itself establish an ordering, so any ordering shown is descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [b] Ordering basis, Experiment 4, the FGO whole-flight batch against the smoothed UKF (H4.3). Metric: indoor horizontal RMSE in the world frame, no alignment, m. n = 3 flights (same flights, paired). Rule: H4.3: the two RMSEs within 1.5$\times$ of each other in every flight (METHODOLOGY.md:10362). Result: max $\div$ min 1.01--1.02: H4.3 PASSES; which is lower changes between flights (descriptive). Verdict: RULE MET: the similarity is claimed (no ordering).\par
\textit{Note.} [c] Ordering basis, the 'lower' column (which hindsight track has the smaller RMSE in each row). Metric: horizontal RMSE, cm (Experiment 2: mean of the flights in each condition; Experiment 4: per flight, indoor). n = 3 flights per condition in Experiment 2 (4 conditions) and 3 flights in Experiment 4; both hindsight tracks from the same flights. Rule: none: H2.4 and H4.3 test similarity (within 1.5$\times$), not an ordering; no ordering test was pre-registered. Result: the direction per row, as tabulated. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
